description: Read busy periods from Apple Calendar to answer when the user is free. Use this to check a specific time or find open slots in a period.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the requested period. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a local calendar day, or an ISO 8601 date-time with its time zone offset.

params.name: end
params.description: Exclusive end of the requested period. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a local calendar day, or an ISO 8601 date-time with its time zone offset.

evals.utterance: Am I free tomorrow between 2 and 4?
